753:t_025:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I have truly received your feelings!」

753:t_025:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「We will carve out the future!」

753:t_026:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Thank you, $$マリーダ$$! I'll use the power you guided me to!」

753:t_026:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$! Now, we become one!」

753:t_027:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$... So you believe in the future too.」

753:t_027:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...$$ララァ$$... I can see the time too...」

753:t_027:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What is this power...!? It isn't just $$地球の次元力$$! This is... human will...!?」

753:t_027:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Now we have gained power that rivals yours!」

753:t_027:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Impossible! The $$御使い$$s are the lives of $$エス・テラン$$ integrated into one, and I have unified them even further!」

753:t_027:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「The feelings of everyone on Earth are flowing into us right now!」

753:t_027:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now, those feelings become one! Through our bodies!」

753:t_027:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Accepting others and living together... Have all Earthlings finally reached the truth, here at the very end!」

753:t_028:2.en:
$$不動$$
「They no longer need a guide.」

753:t_028:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That old man! Butting in again!」

753:t_028:5.en:
$$不動$$
「This time it truly is farewell. You will graduate completely from me... no, from the shackles of the higher-dimensional life form.」

753:t_028:6.en:
$$不動$$
「Advance, together with love, courage, and hope.」

753:t_029:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It seems he came to witness how the battle ends, too.」

753:t_029:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...At last, a species that has reached the truth... emerges...」

753:t_029:4.en:
$n
「That's right, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Don't think you're the only special one!」

753:t_029:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We're fighting with the feelings of the Earth... no, of all living things united as one!」

753:t_029:6.en:
$n
「Not even your god-power can break our hearts!」

753:t_029:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Very well. I shall acknowledge you all anew.」

753:t_029:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Though only a few minutes remain, I bless the Earthlings who have grasped the truth.」

753:t_029:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Even now, you still won't lose your composure!?」

753:t_029:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am an immortal being. As long as that remains, my victory is unshakable.」

753:t_029:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「It looks like we're not the only ones who got stronger from that cheer from Earth just now.」

753:t_029:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What are you talking about?」

753:t_029:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Your feelings too!」

753:t_030:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The power of infinite life called me back from the nightmare.」

753:t_030:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$! What can you possibly do now!?」

753:t_030:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Taking your prized Supreme God from you... seems quite impossible.」

753:t_030:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... This monster, gathering the power of the $$スフィア$$s, looks like it will grant my one and only wish.」

753:t_030:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Madness! You would throw away eternity yourself!?」

753:t_030:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You wouldn't understand, you who tried to become a god... to become eternity.」

753:t_030:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I have lived until today... only for that.」

753:t_031:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Why!? Why would $$至高神Ｚ$$ try to grant $$アサキム$$'s wish!?」

753:t_031:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You, who cast away the meaning of life, cannot become one with the $$太極$$... with the Supreme God.」

753:t_031:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The meaning of the $$太極$$... That is, in other words... life...」

753:t_031:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My feelings have reached them... The rest is...」

753:t_031:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Leave it to us, $$アサキム$$! Your wish is received!」

753:t_031:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「To end everything, we will grant your wish with our own hands!」

753:t_031:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't think you can win, you mere Earthlings!」

753:t_031:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am a being that has surpassed even the $$御使い$$s! I alone can survive the universe's great collapse!」

753:t_031:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's the first time you've shown anger from the bottom of your heart.」

753:t_031:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So a man who calls himself a god gives in to raw emotion.」

753:t_031:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is... the emotion of the $$ドクトリン$$ I absorbed...!」

753:t_031:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「You thought you had surpassed humans, surpassed the $$御使い$$s, and reached godhood!」

753:t_031:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you raged at the $$ドクトリン$$ who banished you, grieved over your lot, found joy in becoming a god, and reveled in that power!」

753:t_031:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「What you've been doing is no different from a human, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_031:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We can't lose to an opponent who is neither immortal nor a god!」

753:t_031:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「From here on, it's a fair and square fight!」

753:t_031:19.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am... a god! The only being who can save this universe!」

753:t_031:20.en:
$$レド$$
「Humans aren't gods, and they don't need to become gods!」

753:t_031:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you had lived alongside us, there surely would have been another path for you!」

753:t_031:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But you drowned in that power and strayed from the path!」

753:t_031:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「A guy like that isn't a god or anything! He's just a villain!」

753:t_031:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll overcome it! If you use that power to block the future, I'll get past it!」

753:t_031:31.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That is our mission... the mission of $c!」

753:t_031:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Mere humans have no right to deny me!」

753:t_031:33.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's that arrogance that brings war to the universe!」
